description: This class provides utility methods for managing daemon threads within the OpenMRS platform. It handles the creation, execution, and management of background tasks that run with elevated privileges, including module startup, scheduled tasks, and user creation in a privileged context. It also ensures that the tasks are executed within the proper session and security context.

classes.name: Daemon.DaemonThread
classes.description: Custom Thread subclass used internally to execute tasks with information about exceptions and return values.

methods.name: startModule
methods.description: Starts a given module in a separate thread with elevated privileges, optionally refreshing the application context.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified roles in a privileged context executed within a daemon thread.

methods.name: executeScheduledTask
methods.description: Runs a scheduled task within a daemon thread, ensuring it is executed with elevated privileges.

methods.name: runInNewDaemonThread
methods.description: Spawns a new daemon thread to run the given runnable or callable, only callable from existing daemon threads.

methods.name: runInDaemonThread
methods.description: Runs a task in a new daemon thread with elevated privileges, optionally returning a future.

methods.name: runInDaemonThreadWithoutResult
methods.description: Runs a runnable in a daemon thread without returning a result, only from a daemon thread.

methods.name: runInDaemonThreadAndWait
methods.description: Runs a runnable in a daemon thread and waits for its completion.

methods.name: isDaemonThread
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is a daemon thread managed by this class or a web daemon.

methods.name: runStartupForService
methods.description: Invokes the onStartup method of a given OpenmrsService implementation within a daemon thread.
